name: contacts
description: An address book that fills itself: every incoming message adds its sender, and other mini-apps resolve names/addresses through the contacts.lookup capability.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 013_contacts.sql, hot-loads the app).
Contacts grow automatically from incoming mail (with the email package) — or add them manually via the API.
Other mini-apps resolve people via the contacts.lookup capability (no hard-coded URLs).
